correctness.rationale: For the ordinary dodecahedron GP(10,2), the exact graph Cech r=3 nerve has facets N[u]∪N[v] over its 30 edges. All 30 maximal facets have size six and independent subface construction gives f=(20,150,380,410,180,30), 1,170 nonempty faces. Reconstructed the fixed vertex-order matching: 578 disjoint pairs, one critical vertex, one critical triangle, twelve critical 3-simplices, and full 4,160-Hasse-incidence directed acyclicity. Independently implemented integral orientation of all simplices and recursive elimination of matched 2→3 unit pivots; for each of twelve critical 3-cells the coefficient on the critical 2-cell is exactly zero, not merely zero modulo 2. Thus the Morse 2-skeleton is S² and twelve attaching maps have degree zero in π₂(S²)=Z, giving S²∨(∨^{12}S³). Purity in dimension five rules out shellability. The independent truncated chain-rank check in lower degrees is corroborative; omitted higher boundary ranks do not replace this integral argument.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical cubic distance-regular/Platonic graph at its first non-girth-stable Čech threshold. The mixed homotopy S²∨12S³, inferred from a vanishing integral attaching-degree matrix rather than just Betti numbers, is a substantive exact finite homotopy invariant and establishes a structural non-shellability obstruction.
